sentences.en: Riverside Station is a small train station in the green hills.
sentences.zh: 河畔站是绿色群山间的一个小火车站。

sentences.en: Wang Shifu has worked there as a porter for thirty years.
sentences.zh: 王师傅在那里当了三十年的搬运工。

sentences.en: Every day, he transports travelers' heavy bags from the platform to the buses outside.
sentences.zh: 每天，他把旅客沉重的行李从站台搬到外面的公交车上。

sentences.en: He is old now, but his back is still as strong as a young tree.
sentences.zh: 他如今上了年纪，但脊背依然像小树一样结实。

sentences.en: All the travelers know him, and everybody in the town likes him.
sentences.zh: 旅客们都认识他，镇上的每个人也都喜欢他。

sentences.en: One cold evening in November, the last train left at nine o'clock.
sentences.zh: 十一月一个寒冷的夜晚，末班车九点钟开走了。

sentences.en: The station became quiet, and the long platform was almost empty.
sentences.zh: 车站安静下来，长长的站台上几乎空无一人。

sentences.en: Wang Shifu walked slowly along the platform with his lamp, as he always did.
sentences.zh: 王师傅像往常一样，提着灯沿着站台慢慢巡视。

sentences.en: Then he saw something strange on the long wooden bench.
sentences.zh: 这时他看见长木凳上有个奇怪的东西。

sentences.en: A black travel bag was sitting there all alone.
sentences.zh: 一只黑色旅行包孤零零地放在那里。

sentences.en: No traveler was anywhere near it.
sentences.zh: 附近一个旅客也没有。

sentences.en: Wang Shifu looked around, but he could see nobody.
sentences.zh: 王师傅环顾四周，但一个人影也没看到。

sentences.en: "Someone has lost this," he said quietly to himself.
sentences.zh: "这是有人丢了。"他轻声自言自语。

sentences.en: He picked up the bag with both hands.
sentences.zh: 他用双手拎起了那只包。

sentences.en: It was heavy, but he did not open it, because it was not his.
sentences.zh: 包很沉，但他没有打开，因为那不是他的东西。

sentences.en: Instead, he carried it straight to the station office.
sentences.zh: 他径直把包送到了车站办公室。

sentences.en: "Please report this lost bag," he told the young officer on duty.
sentences.zh: "请登记上报这只遗失的包。"他对值班的年轻站员说。

sentences.en: Together with the manager, they inspected the bag and wrote down everything.
sentences.zh: 他们和站长一起检查了包，并把每样东西记录在案。

sentences.en: Inside the bag, they found three things.
sentences.zh: 包里共有三样东西。

sentences.en: First, there was a thick envelope full of money.
sentences.zh: 第一样，是一只装满钱的厚信封。

sentences.en: Second, there was a photograph of a young woman holding a small child.
sentences.zh: 第二样，是一张年轻女子抱着小孩的照片。

sentences.en: Third, there was a train ticket to a city far away in the south.
sentences.zh: 第三样，是一张开往南方遥远城市的火车票。

sentences.en: The office manager recorded every detail in his big black book.
sentences.zh: 站长把每个细节都记在了他那本黑色大登记簿里。

sentences.en: "The owner will come back for it," he said.
sentences.zh: "失主会回来找的。"他说。

sentences.en: "Money like this must be very important to somebody."
sentences.zh: "这样一笔钱，对某个人来说一定非常重要。"

sentences.en: Wang Shifu went home, but he did not sleep well that night.
sentences.zh: 王师傅回了家，但那晚睡得并不安稳。

sentences.en: He kept thinking about the person who had lost the bag.
sentences.zh: 他一直在想那个丢包的人。

sentences.en: The next morning, he arrived at the station two hours earlier than usual.
sentences.zh: 第二天一早，他比平时提前两个小时到了车站。

sentences.en: At eight o'clock, a young woman ran into the station.
sentences.zh: 八点钟，一个年轻女子跑进了车站。

sentences.en: Her face was white, and her eyes were red from crying.
sentences.zh: 她脸色发白，眼睛哭得通红。

sentences.en: "My bag! I lost my black bag on the bench!" she cried.
sentences.zh: "我的包！我的黑包丢在长凳上了！"她喊道。

sentences.en: "My little son is sick in the south, and that money is for his hospital!"
sentences.zh: "我的小儿子在南方生病了，那笔钱是给他住院用的！"

sentences.en: The office manager stood up and asked her to sit down.
sentences.zh: 站长站起身，请她坐下。

sentences.en: "Please describe your bag for me," he said gently.
sentences.zh: "请描述一下您的包。"他温和地说。

sentences.en: "It is black, with a small red flower on the side," she answered.
sentences.zh: "是黑色的，侧面有一朵小红花。"她答道。

sentences.en: "There is a photograph of me and my boy inside it."
sentences.zh: "里面还有一张我和我儿子的照片。"

sentences.en: Everything she said matched the record in the black book.
sentences.zh: 她说的每一项都与登记簿上的记录吻合。

sentences.en: The manager opened the safe and brought out the bag.
sentences.zh: 站长打开保险柜，取出了那只包。

sentences.en: The young woman took it with shaking hands.
sentences.zh: 年轻女子双手颤抖着接过包。

sentences.en: She counted the money quickly, and not one yuan was missing.
sentences.zh: 她迅速点了点钱，一分都没少。

sentences.en: Then she turned to Wang Shifu, who was standing quietly by the door.
sentences.zh: 然后她转向安静站在门边的王师傅。

sentences.en: "Was it you, sir, who found my bag?" she asked.
sentences.zh: "先生，是您捡到了我的包吗？"她问。

sentences.en: "Yes, madam," the old porter answered with a small smile.
sentences.zh: "是我，女士。"老搬运工带着一丝微笑回答。

sentences.en: The woman pulled two hundred yuan from the envelope and held it out to him.
sentences.zh: 女子从信封里抽出两百元，递到他面前。

sentences.en: "Please take this," she said.
sentences.zh: "请收下这个。"她说。

sentences.en: "You have saved my son's life."
sentences.zh: "您救了我儿子的命。"

sentences.en: But Wang Shifu shook his head and softly pushed the money back.
sentences.zh: 但王师傅摇了摇头，轻轻把钱推了回去。

sentences.en: "Keep it for your boy," he said.
sentences.zh: "留给你孩子用吧。"他说。

sentences.en: "I only did what any honest person should do."
sentences.zh: "我只不过做了任何诚实的人都该做的事。"

sentences.en: The woman looked at him, and her eyes filled with warm tears.
sentences.zh: 女子望着他，眼里涌起了温暖的泪水。

sentences.en: The story traveled through the town faster than any train could.
sentences.zh: 这件事传遍小镇的速度比任何火车都快。

sentences.en: Soon people were calling him "the honest porter" with real respect.
sentences.zh: 很快，人们开始满怀敬意地称他为"诚实的搬运工"。

sentences.en: Wang Shifu still carries bags at Riverside Station today.
sentences.zh: 如今王师傅仍在河畔站搬运行李。

sentences.en: Travelers prefer his two strong arms more than any young man's back.
sentences.zh: 旅客们宁可要他两条结实的胳膊，也不愿找年轻人的脊背。

sentences.en: And he always says the same thing: "A good name is worth more than money."
sentences.zh: 他总说同一句话："好名声比金钱更珍贵。"

questions.q: What is Wang Shifu's job at Riverside Station?
options: Train driver.
Station porter.
Office manager.
Police officer.
questions.explain: 第2句 "he worked there as a porter for thirty years" —— 他是搬运工。

questions.q: What three things were found inside the lost bag?
options: Money, a photograph, and a train ticket.
Clothes, books, and shoes.
Food, a lamp, and a map.
A radio, keys, and coins.
questions.explain: 包里三样东西：厚厚的钱、年轻女子抱孩子的照片、一张去南方的火车票。

questions.q: Why did the young woman need the money so badly?
options: To buy a new travel bag.
To pay for her sick son's hospital.
To travel to Beijing.
To open a small shop.
questions.explain: "My little son is sick in the south, and that money is for his hospital"。

questions.q: What did Wang Shifu do when the woman offered him two hundred yuan?
options: He took it happily.
He asked for more.
He refused it and told her to keep it for her son.
He gave it to the office manager.
questions.explain: 他摇头把钱推回去说 "Keep it for your boy" —— 拒绝了酬谢。

questions.q: What does Wang Shifu mean by "A good name is worth more than money"?
options: Honesty and a good reputation are more valuable than wealth.
He wants to be paid in coins.
Names can be sold in the market.
Money is useless in small towns.
questions.explain: 全文主旨：他拒绝酬金、归还失物，说明在他心中好名声（诚实）比金钱更贵重。
